purpose: Manuscript-support metadata for the ZZ4 feature-map parameters used in Wave 1.
alpha_status: Records the manuscript convention for the Qiskit ZZFeatureMap phase scaling used to describe the fixed ZZ4 map; alpha was not an independently varied runtime option in the Wave 1 execution script.
fidelity_circuit: U(x_i) followed by inverse U(x_j), then measure all qubits
all_zero_bitstring_policy: all-zero probability is interpreted as hardware kernel entry
symmetrization_status_wave1: Wave 1 contained no directed or replicated observations: each unordered pair (i, j) with i <= j was measured exactly once. The duplicate-averaging branch of the policy was therefore inactive, and symmetrization reduced to mirroring the measured upper triangle, K_r(j, i) = K_r(i, j). This is consistent with the uniform measurement_policy column of the circuit inventory across all 900 circuits.
